brief: Create a poster promoting a film series devoted to director Dario Argento at Filmpodium Zürich, making clear that his films are the focus of the cinema’s programme.

Create a poster announcing the exhibition “Death by Landscape” by Dorota Gawęda and Eglė Kulbokaitė at Haus für Kunst Uri. Its purpose is to introduce the exhibition and identify the two artists, without suggesting a political message or a specific interpretation of the work.

Create a poster presenting Salon d’Amour, a participatory performance by conceptual artist Margret Wibmer in Amsterdam. Introduce the project as an artistic performance involving audience participation, without implying a broader theme or message.
Create a poster announcing an event featuring Alex Hanimann in Tobias Lenggenhager’s production hall, communicating Hanimann as the central subject and the production hall as the setting.

Create a poster promoting a museum exhibition of Alice Creischer and Andreas Siekmann’s project exploring the circulation of labour, capital and life through the concept of a supply chain. The purpose is to introduce the exhibition and communicate its central subject to potential museum visitors.

Create a poster announcing a talk by Anastasia Temirkhan on the theme of semantic shapes, presented as part of ESAD’s MA Open Talks programme in Design Communication. Its purpose is to publicize the talk and clearly identify the speaker, topic, and programme.

Create a poster promoting an exhibition marking Alf Lechner’s centenary, with a focus on steel as the material of his sculptural work. Communicate the anniversary and the exhibition’s central subject without requiring any particular title wording.

Create a conceptual poster that questions how consumerism shapes culture. Use the idea of 'Buy Buy Culture' to invite reflection on the relationship between buying and cultural life, without promoting a product or sale.

Create a poster for the Swiss Trade Union Federation’s May Day campaign, promoting solidarity over hostility and emphasizing the strength of standing together. The purpose is to communicate a message of unity in the context of the workers’ holiday, rather than advertise a specific gathering or programme.

Create a poster promoting a film programme dedicated to director Dario Argento at Filmpodium Zürich. The central task is to communicate the focus on Argento’s work and encourage attendance at the screenings.
Create a poster promoting a joint record-release celebration for Elian Zeitel and Itakiry. The central purpose is to announce the event and communicate that it marks new releases from both acts.

Create a poster announcing an exhibition of work by artist Amol K Patil, titled Many Kilometres, Several Words. The central purpose is to introduce the exhibition and identify the artist, without assigning a specific theme or message to the work.
Create a poster promoting the 2025 edition of Fumetto, a comic festival. Its central purpose is to identify the festival and build awareness of it as an event focused on comics.

Create a public art poster exploring the idea of Confoederatio in a Swiss context. Invite reflection on how different places and cultural associations can form a shared identity, without presenting a specific event or political proposal.
Create a poster celebrating the 30th anniversary of Haus Schwarzenberg in 2025, marking thirty years since 1995 and communicating that the anniversary celebrations continue throughout the year.

Create a poster announcing an exhibition of Anna Fasshauer’s work at the Fabienne Levy gallery. The central purpose is to introduce the artist and her sculpture to the public and promote the exhibition.
Create a poster presenting Confoederatio as an artistic project for public display, introducing the work to viewers rather than advertising an event or inviting attendance.
Create a poster promoting a sex-themed pub quiz, making the event’s subject and quiz format clear and encouraging people to take part.

Create a poster presenting an experimental variable-font project that explores the relationship between letterforms, handwriting gestures, and asemic writing. Its purpose is to introduce the project and communicate its central concept: repeated handwriting as a physical practice that connects recognizable letters with expressive, nonliteral marks.

Create a poster advocating an amendment to Article 3(3) of Germany’s Basic Law to protect people from discrimination based on sexual and gender identity. Communicate this call for constitutional protection through the principle that everyone’s human dignity is inviolable.

Create a poster promoting the 2025 open day at ECAL, the Lausanne art and design school. Its purpose is to invite visitors to discover the school and its educational opportunities, spanning foundation, bachelor’s and master’s studies in art and design.

Create a poster promoting a theatrical production of Michael Ende’s The Neverending Story for audiences aged ten and older. Its purpose is to raise awareness of the production and encourage attendance, clearly identifying the story being staged and its age suitability.

Create a provocative poster using the idea of 'Eat the Filthy Rich' to satirize extreme wealth and inequality. Communicate a confrontational social comment without presenting it as a particular campaign or event.
Create a poster announcing an exhibition of cyan’s work spanning 1990–2025. The central purpose is to introduce this survey of their creative output and generate interest in visiting the exhibition.

Create a poster announcing ECAL’s 2025 diploma exhibition, showcasing the graduating work of Bachelor’s and Master’s students at the Lausanne University of Art and Design. Its purpose is to publicize the exhibition and identify it as a presentation of the school’s graduate work.

Create a poster promoting the theatrical production Der kleine Vampir (The Little Vampire), communicating the play’s identity and its suitability for children aged six and older to encourage attendance.

Design a poster announcing a museum exhibition devoted to the photographic work of Fotoatelier Wolgensinger. The purpose is to introduce the studio’s work to the public and build awareness of the exhibition.
Create a poster promoting Staatstheater Mainz’s production of Dario Fo’s play “Bezahlt wird nicht.” The purpose is to introduce the theatre production and build interest in seeing it.

Create a poster publicising the centenary of Neues Frankfurt, the modernist architecture and urban-development programme associated with Frankfurt. The aim is to raise awareness of the anniversary and direct people to further information about its programme of activities.

Create an election campaign poster for SP Schlieren, the local Social Democratic Party, encouraging voters to support its List 1. Communicate an inclusive message of politics for everyone, reflecting the campaign’s multilingual emphasis without implying specific policy promises.

Create a poster presenting New Faces, a student design project exploring how people perceive and recognize faces in unfamiliar forms. Spark curiosity about the project without requiring literal portraiture or a particular technique.

Create a poster introducing Tsüri.ch's Degrowth initiative and the idea of life beyond continual economic growth. Build awareness of this post-growth theme and encourage people to explore it, without assuming a particular event format.
Create a poster promoting the seventh edition of the Tourne-Films Festival Lausanne, a film festival in Lausanne. Its central purpose is to announce the festival and build awareness of the event.
Create a poster announcing the launch of the publication Beyond and an associated performance, communicating the occasion as a public presentation of the project.

Create a poster promoting an exhibition centred on Cy Twombly, Robert Rauschenberg, Jasper Johns, John Cage and Merce Cunningham. Present these five artists and performers as a group of friends, making their collective presence the exhibition’s defining subject rather than focusing on any one individual.
Create a public thank-you poster from the Swiss Architecture Museum to Andreas, with appreciation as its central message.

Create a poster announcing a screening of Kipho, a five-minute German film from 1925, paired with an exhibition documenting the development of the Double U poster project through process plots. Communicate the combined film-screening and exhibition event rather than presenting the poster project alone.
Create a poster promoting the 44th edition of the AMR Jazz Festival. Its central purpose is to announce the festival and build awareness of the jazz music event.

Create a poster promoting the 2025 edition of Der Sommer in Stuttgart, a festival of contemporary music. The central task is to announce the festival and encourage attendance, clearly communicating its identity as a contemporary music event.
Create a poster promoting Ballett Basel’s production of Der Liebhaber. The central task is to identify the production and communicate that it is a ballet performance.

Create a poster promoting a specialist talk by Digitec Galaxus for the Alumni HF KGD community. Connect the talk to Galaxus's theme of offering almost everything for almost everyone and invite the audience to attend.

Create a self-initiated art poster reflecting on how authoritarian figures and ideas recur across history. Use the premise that 'history copies itself' to provoke critical recognition of these repetitions, without promoting an event.
Create a poster announcing a call for entries to Mut zur Wut, an international poster competition. The central purpose is to invite poster submissions and clearly identify the competition.
Create a poster publicizing a literary reading by Gianna Rovere of Episoden von Alltagselefanten. The central purpose is to announce the reading and identify the reader and featured work.

Create a poster promoting a joint event by Salon skug auf Rädern and TONSPUR, centred on democracy-themed speed dating and introductions by people active in democratic initiatives. The communication should make the event’s participatory focus clear and encourage attendance, without implying a specific partisan position.

Create a poster promoting a showcase of work in design, film and art at Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts (HSLU). The central purpose is to raise awareness of the exhibition and invite visitors to discover the work on display.

Create a poster promoting a museum exhibition about Ferdinand Hodler and his role as a model for Swiss art. Communicate the exhibition’s focus on the artist and his significance within Swiss artistic culture, making its subject and purpose clear.

Create a poster announcing the global call for entries for GDC Award 2025, the Graphic Design in China biennial. Its purpose is to raise awareness of the award and encourage submissions of graphic design work from around the world.

Create a poster promoting the 2025 edition of Printemps Culturel, a cultural festival in the Neuchâtel region focused on Korean culture. Communicate the festival’s identity and central theme, raising awareness of its cultural programme.

Create a poster promoting the group art exhibition Passato Presente at Helmhaus in Zurich. Communicate that it brings together work by multiple artists, with the purpose of raising public awareness of the exhibition.

Create a poster announcing an international carnival gathering in Willisau. The central subject is a meeting of carnival revelers, with masked and costumed celebration providing the context; the communication should introduce the event and convey its festive, communal spirit.

Create a poster promoting an exhibition about Lucerne’s poster scene, presented by the poster collection of the Basel School of Design. Communicate the exhibition’s focus on poster design from Lucerne and encourage visitors to explore it.

Create a poster presenting an individual art and design project that explores imagined Swiss landscapes through digital image collage. Communicate its central inquiry into how combining multiple viewpoints and blurring image boundaries can create more fluid spaces and nonlinear narratives. The purpose is to introduce the project and its creative concept, rather than promote an event or invite attendance.

Create a poster promoting the summer concert programme at Scène Ella Fitzgerald, an outdoor stage in Geneva’s Parc La Grange. The central purpose is to raise awareness of the concert series and encourage attendance, rather than to present a tribute to Ella Fitzgerald.
Create a poster promoting a live concert by Mac DeMarco, with the artist and the performance as the central message.

Create a poster announcing the 2025 swimming parade on Vienna’s Danube Canal and encouraging participation. Communicate the event as a collective swim and make clear that a ticket is required to join the swimming parade.
Create a poster promoting Heim Test 2025, a music-led club event from Heim. Build interest in the event and make its connection to the club clear, without prescribing a lineup or visual treatment.
Create a poster announcing the spring 2025 edition of the Kein Kino lecture series. Its purpose is to promote the series as a programme of talks featuring invited speakers and studios.

Create a poster for the Zurich Museum of Design around oxytocin, the hormone associated with bonding and connection. Present it as an engaging creative theme that sparks curiosity rather than announcing a specific event.

Create a poster introducing and promoting Potsa Lotsa, a musical ensemble bringing together wind instruments, strings, keyboards and percussion. The purpose is to establish awareness of the group and its music, rather than announce a specific concert or event.

Create a poster promoting Hello Image, a museum exhibition exploring how objects are staged and presented visually. Communicate the exhibition’s focus on the relationship between objects and the images through which they are encountered.

Create a poster promoting the 2025 edition of the Lausanne Underground Film & Music Festival, its 24th edition. The central task is to establish the festival’s identity and raise awareness of an event devoted to underground film and music.

Create a poster promoting Playtime 2025, a music festival showcasing the music-related degree programmes of Bern Academy of the Arts. Communicate the festival’s breadth across performance, composition, sound arts and music research, and build awareness of the event.
Create a poster introducing the 2025–26 season at Tanzhaus Zürich. Its purpose is to promote the dance institution’s forthcoming season as a whole, rather than a specific performance or event.
Create a poster announcing an exhibition of work by Oliver Ressler. The central communication task is to introduce the featured artist and raise awareness of the exhibition.

Create a poster promoting a poetry programme event featuring Karen Solie at Haus für Poesie. Its purpose is to introduce the featured poet through her work and encourage interest in the event, directing readers to programme and ticket information.

Create a poster introducing Keep Cool, a public collaborative space and workshop exploring creative solutions for cooler cities. Communicate the project’s focus on urban heat and its role as a shared setting for creative exploration and problem-solving.

Create a poster presenting fragments from the film Psychomanteon. The communication should identify the film and make clear that the presentation focuses on excerpts, without implying a full-film screening or adding an unsupported theme.

Create a poetic poster about the excitement of summer from a young child's point of view, especially the desire to go outside and the anticipation of what might happen. Let it function as a personal expression rather than an event announcement.
Create a poster promoting the Opéra national de Paris production of Giacomo Puccini’s opera La Bohème, clearly identifying the work and presenting it as part of the company’s opera programme.

Create an educational poster about menstrual hygiene products, introducing tampons, menstrual cups, pads, and period underwear as options suited to different individual needs. Encourage people to find what works best for them without judging any choice as right or wrong, explain that menstrual cups are as safe as tampons and pads, and challenge the idea that menstruation is dirty. Make clear that menstruation is not exclusive to women: trans and nonbinary people can also have periods.

Create a poster promoting Grand Central, an art exhibition featuring Martin Fengel and Martin Wöhrl at Munich’s Rathausgalerie. Communicate the exhibition’s identity and the two participating artists, making audiences aware of the opportunity to see their work.
Create a poster promoting a staged production of Giacomo Puccini’s Il Trittico, a cycle of three one-act operas. The central purpose is to identify the work and generate interest in the production.

Create a poster presenting Franz Hohler’s Swiss German poem about rushing through everyday life. Introduce the literary work and convey its repeated references to hurried errands, household tasks, social activities, and living itself, suggesting how haste permeates ordinary routines.

Create a poster promoting a reading from the book “Meistgeklickt” by Jolanda Spiess-Hegglin and Hansi Voigt. The central purpose is to announce the literary event and identify the featured book and readers.

Create a commemorative poster paying tribute to Kari Piippo and honoring his memory. Convey a sense of remembrance and the sorrow of losing someone dear, with a reflection on the passing of loved ones.
Create a poster promoting the 2025 edition of the Sonic Matter festival, introducing its “Remake” theme and building awareness of the event.

Create a poster announcing the 2025–2026 performing arts season of Théâtre populaire romand, a theatre and live arts centre in La Chaux-de-Fonds. The purpose is to introduce the institution’s new season as a whole, rather than promote an individual production.

Create a poster announcing the 2025 presentation of the Canton of Zürich’s Golden Medal of Honour to Heidi Diggelmann and Ilma Rakusa. Its purpose is to communicate the distinction and celebrate the two honourees.

Create an informational poster presenting climate goals: limiting global warming to 1.5°C, reducing emissions by 55% by 2030, reaching net-zero emissions, and achieving climate neutrality by 2045. Its purpose is to make these headline targets clear and understandable, without attributing them to an unspecified organisation or campaign.

Create a poster that playfully questions Helvetica's place as a familiar typographic convention. Use the idea of 'Sorry Helvetica' to invite a fresh view of letterforms, without promoting an event or product.

Create a poster presenting Niklaus Troxler’s New Year message for 2025. The central idea is rethinking—inviting reflection on familiar ways of thinking as a new year begins—rather than promoting an event or product.
Create a poster promoting the Weltformat Graphic Design Festival, clearly identifying the event and communicating its focus on graphic design.

Create a poster presenting Switzerland through its cantons and municipalities. The purpose is to offer an overview of the country’s constituent communities and express the idea of many individual places belonging to one national whole.

Create a poster promoting Au Diapason, a musical comedy presented by Théâtre Am Stram Gram for audiences aged eight and above, including adults. The purpose is to introduce the production and encourage attendance, communicating its musical-theatre format and broad age appeal.

Create a poster promoting the theatre production Start in 1 Minute, described as a gentle evening of theatre staged in the heated grandstand of a harness-racing track. Communicate the performance and its distinctive setting to prospective attendees.

Create a poster announcing an exhibition of Vanessa Safavi’s work at Fabienne Levy under the title Metaphors for Gravity. The purpose is to promote the gallery exhibition, making the artist and the show’s identity clear.

Create a poster promoting the Philharmonisches Staatsorchester Mainz’s symphony concert season for 2025/26 at Staatstheater Mainz. The central purpose is to announce the orchestra’s season as a whole, rather than an individual concert.

Create an awareness poster about Swiss Overshoot Day on 7 May 2025, marking the point when Switzerland has used its annual share of natural resources and begins consuming beyond Earth’s capacity to replenish them. Communicate the consequences of this overconsumption for nature and life on Earth, and encourage people to help push the date later through more sustainable use of resources.

Create a poster promoting the 2025 edition of Zürcher Theater Spektakel, a theatre festival in Zurich. The central task is to announce the festival and encourage attendance, keeping the event’s identity clear without focusing on individual productions or secondary programme items.

Create a poster promoting Theater Oberhausen’s production of Sankt Falstaff, a play by Ewald Palmetshofer freely based on Shakespeare’s Henry IV, as part of the theatre’s 2025/26 season. The purpose is to introduce the production and build awareness of its place in the season’s programme.

Create a poster introducing Widerstand, an exploratory project around the idea of resistance. Give the research-led project a public identity and invite curiosity without assigning it a particular political cause or event.

Create a poster promoting a free concert event in Geneva featuring bands and choirs from the Union genevoise des musiques et chorales. The purpose is to publicize the musical gathering and invite people to attend, making its live music offering and free admission clear.

Create an independent statement poster rejecting the normalization of fascist salutes. Communicate a warning about the persistence of authoritarian symbols today without attaching the message to a particular campaign.

Create a poster promoting the Festival d’Art Brut, centred on the project Regarde bien ce que je suis, which brings together theatre, installation and music. Communicate the festival’s focus on art brut and the multidisciplinary nature of this featured work.

Create a poster publicizing an art exhibition presenting Gareth McConnell’s project Window, identified with the period 2011–2022. The communication should introduce the artist and project and make clear that the work is being exhibited.

Create an institutional publicity poster for the Central and University Library of Lucerne (ZHB). The purpose is to build recognition of the library and direct people to its website for further information, rather than promote a particular event or programme.

Create a poster promoting an exhibition of Tadanori Yokoo’s original poster art spanning 1965–2025. Its purpose is to introduce the artist’s poster work and invite visitors to explore this six-decade selection.

Create a poster promoting Theater Basel’s production of Turandot, the opera by Giacomo Puccini. The central purpose is to introduce the production and build awareness of it as part of the theatre’s opera programme.

Create a poster promoting a public art and music project in Zurich, with concerts at six locations connected to the city’s music scene. The project explores the relationship between design, place, and sound through six specially created instruments and live performances. Communicate the project’s concept and the opportunity to experience it in the city’s public spaces.
